title: One 800-kiloton nuclear warhead over Chicago, street by street

strikes.weapon: Unattributed submarine-launched ballistic missile, one warhead
strikes.notes: Hero strike and the only strike. 800 kt is an illustrative simulation choice at the top of the range of the heaviest modern strategic warheads (research A6, A7); it is not a real US-held warhead (A6) and the attacker is deliberately unattributed. Air burst chosen for maximum blast and thermal reach with little local fallout (A16). Ground zero is the Loop; launch 9:15 a.m. CDT, impact about 9:26 a.m. CDT, on a Tuesday (no real-event date).
